about: The elevator announcer's lines. `text` is sent to ElevenLabs exactly as written (audio tags included); `plain` is the subtitle. See docs/VOICE.md.

shortlist.name: Bella
shortlist.description: ElevenLabs library voice 'Bella - Professional, Bright, Warm': American, middle-aged, professional; warm, bright and polished, medium-high pitch.
shortlist.why: Its own description is the default register: bright, warm, professional. Chosen as the default from the description alone (nobody has heard it).

shortlist.name: Sarah
shortlist.description: ElevenLabs library voice 'Sarah - Mature, Reassuring, Confident': American, professional, labelled for entertainment and TV; warm and reassuring.
shortlist.why: A reassuring presenter: the 'everything is fine' side of the character.

shortlist.name: Brian
shortlist.description: ElevenLabs library voice 'Brian - Deep, Resonant and Comforting': American, middle-aged man; resonant and comforting, described as great for advertisements.
shortlist.why: An advertising voice, and a male alternative so the owner can compare.

voices.settingsNote: Brian uses exactly Bella's text and settings (slip stability 0.6 included) so the two compare fairly; VOICE.md gives no different setting for a deep voice, and his three audition takes, made with these settings, are reused.

playroom.title: The Playroom count
playroom.about: The lift's voice running hide-and-seek on the Playroom floor (docs/floors/playarea.md sections 3 and 10). Played by the count on screen (T15e) by line id, not dealt by moment: godot/client/count_lines.gd maps each count event to its line id.
playroom.countdown: Numbers recorded: one to ten, and twenty, thirty, forty. The voice says forty, thirty and twenty as they pass (never on the count's first second, which belongs to 'Coming, ready or not!'), then every second from ten to one. The bell carries the seconds in between. 13 clips cover every count length (30, 35, 40, 45 s) instead of 45, and the last ten are the part worth hearing every second: the bell rises over the last five.
playroom.audition: Three takes of each line and two of each number. For the numbers, pick one take that sounds the same across all thirteen, since they play one after another. Until you choose, take 1 plays.

tape.title: The orientation tape
tape.about: Continuance's induction video (docs/floors/story.md section 2), played once on joining by godot/client/orientation_tape.gd, by line id, never dealt by moment. One recording per beat; the tape's shots share it. A tape is an object in the world, recorded once, so only Bella reads it.
tape.audition: One take of each beat. The tape cuts its pictures on the pauses between sentences, so a re-take needs the cue times rebuilt (node godot/tools/tape_cues.mjs).

board.when: the start of a run, in the car before the doors open

doors.when: the doors open on a new floor (not the run's first floor: the boarding line covers it)

left.when: the car leaves the crew on the floor (unloaded, or the bell rang with nobody aboard)

arrived.when: the called car arrives and its doors open

bell.when: seven seconds before the doors close while boarding

ride.when: the car rides down to a deeper floor

banked.when: the crew rides up and banks

taken.when: someone is caught by the Orderly

wipe.when: nobody is left: the run is wiped

slip.when: at most once per run, floor 2 or deeper, at a quiet moment; then a pause and the resume line

resume.when: straight after the slip and its pause, as if nothing happened

blackout.when: a few seconds before the long blackout while the crew waits for the car

lights.when: the lights come back after the blackout as the car arrives

quota.when: the crew has recorded this floor's quota: the call button now works (North Star C9)

count_last.when: Playroom: the call button is pressed, which starts the last count instead of the usual wait

count_hide.when: Playroom: a count starts; the 6 s to hide begin

count_coming.when: Playroom: the 6 s are over and the search begins

count_number.when: Playroom: the countdown, on the second it names (forty, thirty, twenty as they pass, then ten to one)

count_found.when: Playroom: a player is found; the caption carries their name

tape.when: never dealt by the announcer: the orientation tape plays these by id (godot/client/orientation_tape.gd)

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Good morning, and welcome aboard! [short pause] Your sentence begins on the way down.
lines.plain: Good morning, and welcome aboard! Your sentence begins on the way down.
lines.note: Hotel-lobby warmth. 'Sentence' lands as good news.

lines.text: [warmly] Welcome aboard! Every floor you visit brings your freedom a little closer. [short pause] Statistically.
lines.plain: Welcome aboard! Every floor you visit brings your freedom a little closer. Statistically.
lines.note: The last word is an afterthought, still smiling, not a joke it knows it made.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Welcome back! [short pause] Your debt to society has been calculated. [warmly] Please don't ask to see it.
lines.plain: Welcome back! Your debt to society has been calculated. Please don't ask to see it.
lines.note: The refusal is offered as a kindness.

lines.text: [delighted] Good morning, crew! Today's descent is brought to you by the court's decision. [short pause] Enjoy your stay.
lines.plain: Good morning, crew! Today's descent is brought to you by the court's decision. Enjoy your stay.
lines.note: Sponsor-read cheer.

lines.text: [professional] Please keep your arms, legs and hopes inside the car. [short pause] [warmly] Going down shortly.
lines.plain: Please keep your arms, legs and hopes inside the car. Going down shortly.
lines.note: 'Hopes' gets no extra weight.

lines.text: [delighted] Doors opening! [short pause] This floor used to be a hospital. It may still think it is.
lines.plain: Doors opening! This floor used to be a hospital. It may still think it is.
lines.note: Tour-guide trivia. The second sentence is fond, not ominous.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Doors opening! Please collect your belongings, and anything else you find.
lines.plain: Doors opening! Please collect your belongings, and anything else you find.
lines.note: Standard airline cadence; the end is said exactly like the start.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] Doors opening! [short pause] Remember, anything you record belongs to us. Anything that follows you is yours.
lines.plain: Doors opening! Remember, anything you record belongs to us. Anything that follows you is yours.
lines.note: Terms and conditions, happily.

lines.text: [warmly] Here we are! Mind the gap, [short pause] and the staff.
lines.plain: Here we are! Mind the gap, and the staff.
lines.note: 'And the staff' is the same warm tone, not a warning.

lines.text: [delighted] Doors opening! The lights on this floor are on for your comfort. [short pause] Mostly.
lines.plain: Doors opening! The lights on this floor are on for your comfort. Mostly.
lines.note: Afterthought, still smiling.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] The car is leaving now! [short pause] Call any time. It usually comes.
lines.plain: The car is leaving now! Call any time. It usually comes.
lines.note: 'Usually' is meant as reassurance.

lines.text: [warmly] We'll be just upstairs! [short pause] [delighted] Please enjoy the quiet.
lines.plain: We'll be just upstairs! Please enjoy the quiet.
lines.note: A parent leaving a child at a party.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] Off we go! [short pause] The car cannot wait on an occupied floor. [warmly] You understand.
lines.plain: Off we go! The car cannot wait on an occupied floor. You understand.
lines.note: Policy, not cruelty.

lines.text: [warmly] You're in good hands! [short pause] Not ours.
lines.plain: You're in good hands! Not ours.
lines.note: Short. The second half is just as warm.

lines.text: [professional] The car is now leaving. Should you need us, press the button, [short pause] and be patient.
lines.plain: The car is now leaving. Should you need us, press the button, and be patient.
lines.note: Helpdesk calm.

lines.text: [professional] Thank you for calling! Your car is on its way. [mischievously] Everyone on this floor now knows.
lines.plain: Thank you for calling! Your car is on its way. Everyone on this floor now knows.
lines.note: Customer service, then a little conspiratorial twinkle, as if sharing good gossip.

lines.text: [delighted] Your call is important to us! [short pause] Please wait right there, exactly where you are.
lines.plain: Your call is important to us! Please wait right there, exactly where you are.
lines.note: Hold-music brightness. 'Exactly' slightly slower.

lines.text: [delighted] Call received! [short pause] Estimated arrival: soon. Estimated company: sooner.
lines.plain: Call received! Estimated arrival: soon. Estimated company: sooner.
lines.note: Reads both estimates like train times.

lines.text: [professional] Your car has been requested. [short pause] [warmly] Try to stay somewhere we can find you.
lines.plain: Your car has been requested. Try to stay somewhere we can find you.
lines.note: Caring.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] We heard you! [short pause] [mischievously] So did the floor.
lines.plain: We heard you! So did the floor.
lines.note: The only line allowed a hint of knowing.

lines.text: [delighted] Your car has arrived! [short pause] Please board promptly, and with everyone you came with.
lines.plain: Your car has arrived! Please board promptly, and with everyone you came with.
lines.note: Audition: the normal read. Pleased to see you.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Your car is here! [warmly] We missed you.
lines.plain: Your car is here! We missed you.
lines.note: Short and sweet. 'We missed you' sincere.

lines.text: [delighted] Here we are! [short pause] The doors are open. They will not stay that way.
lines.plain: Here we are! The doors are open. They will not stay that way.
lines.note: Factual, bright.

lines.text: [warmly] Your car has arrived. [short pause] Please count your crew. We already have.
lines.plain: Your car has arrived. Please count your crew. We already have.
lines.note: Gentle.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] All aboard! [short pause] Walking is permitted. Running is understood.
lines.plain: All aboard! Walking is permitted. Running is understood.
lines.note: Safety-notice rhythm.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Doors closing! Please stand on the side of your choice. [short pause] Choose freely!
lines.plain: Doors closing! Please stand on the side of your choice. Choose freely!
lines.note: Game-show host. 'Choose freely' is generous.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Doors closing! Anyone still outside will be welcomed back... eventually.
lines.plain: Doors closing! Anyone still outside will be welcomed back... eventually.
lines.note: The ellipsis is a happy search for the right word.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Doors closing! Red side goes down, yellow side goes home. [short pause] No pressure!
lines.plain: Doors closing! Red side goes down, yellow side goes home. No pressure!
lines.note: Game-show quick.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Last call! The doors do not check who is in them.
lines.plain: Last call! The doors do not check who is in them.
lines.note: Quick and light.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Closing now! If you can hear this from the corridor, [short pause] wave goodbye.
lines.plain: Closing now! If you can hear this from the corridor, wave goodbye.
lines.note: Playful.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Going down! [short pause] Deeper floors pay more, for reasons we have chosen not to explore.
lines.plain: Going down! Deeper floors pay more, for reasons we have chosen not to explore.
lines.note: Proud of the policy. No wink.

lines.text: [delighted] Next stop, further down! [short pause] Beneath the storage halls, you'll find more storage halls.
lines.plain: Next stop, further down! Beneath the storage halls, you'll find more storage halls.
lines.note: Genuinely excited about storage.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Going down! [short pause] Each floor was built on top of the last. Nobody remembers what the first one was for.
lines.plain: Going down! Each floor was built on top of the last. Nobody remembers what the first one was for.
lines.note: Tour-guide trivia.

lines.text: [warmly] Further down we go! [short pause] The pay improves. The air does not.
lines.plain: Further down we go! The pay improves. The air does not.
lines.note: Even, pleasant.

lines.text: [delighted] Going down! [short pause] Fun fact: this shaft is older than the building. All of the buildings.
lines.plain: Going down! Fun fact: this shaft is older than the building. All of the buildings.
lines.note: Delighted by the fact.

lines.text: [ecstatic] Congratulations! [short pause] Your findings have been banked, and your freedom is now SLIGHTLY nearer.
lines.plain: Congratulations! Your findings have been banked, and your freedom is now slightly nearer.
lines.note: Prize-giving. The capital word is emphasised with pride, not irony.

lines.text: [ecstatic] Banked! [short pause] At this rate you will be free in... [short pause] [professional] we'll let you know.
lines.plain: Banked! At this rate you will be free in... we'll let you know.
lines.note: Starts to do the sum, declines.

lines.text: [delighted] Welcome back to the surface! [short pause] Your earnings are safe. [warmly] You may now go down again.
lines.plain: Welcome back to the surface! Your earnings are safe. You may now go down again.
lines.note: A treat being offered.

lines.text: [warmly] A member of your crew has been reassigned. [short pause] [delighted] Their sentence is complete!
lines.plain: A member of your crew has been reassigned. Their sentence is complete!
lines.note: Audition: the bad-news read. Announcing a promotion.

lines.text: [warmly] One of your crew has been admitted. [short pause] [delighted] Visiting hours are over!
lines.plain: One of your crew has been admitted. Visiting hours are over!
lines.note: Hospital reception.

lines.text: [professional] A crew member is no longer recording. [short pause] [warmly] Their equipment may be collected.
lines.plain: A crew member is no longer recording. Their equipment may be collected.
lines.note: Lost-property tone.

lines.text: [delighted] The staff have found one of you! [short pause] Please continue working.
lines.plain: The staff have found one of you! Please continue working.
lines.note: Good news.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] And that is everyone! [short pause] Thank you for your service. A new crew will be along shortly.
lines.plain: And that is everyone! Thank you for your service. A new crew will be along shortly.
lines.note: End of a shift. Brisk, satisfied, already thinking about the next one.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] That concludes today's descent! [short pause] All sentences served. [warmly] In a manner of speaking.
lines.plain: That concludes today's descent! All sentences served. In a manner of speaking.
lines.note: Closing announcement.

lines.text: [warmly] Nobody left to board. [short pause] [delighted] The car thanks you for your patience!
lines.plain: Nobody left to board. The car thanks you for your patience!
lines.note: To an empty landing.

lines.text: [Flat, quiet, no warmth, close to the microphone] Nobody has ever finished their sentence.
lines.plain: Nobody has ever finished their sentence.
lines.note: Audition: the slip. No smile at all, as if someone else is holding the microphone. Followed in game by a pause and resume_1.

lines.text: [Flat, quiet, no warmth, close to the microphone] It was a hospital before you came. It will be one after.
lines.plain: It was a hospital before you came. It will be one after.
lines.note: The mask off, as slip_1.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Thank you for travelling down with us! Have a wonderful floor.
lines.plain: Thank you for travelling down with us! Have a wonderful floor.
lines.note: Back to full cheer at once, as if nothing happened.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] Where were we? [short pause] Ah yes. Enjoy your floor!
lines.plain: Where were we? Ah yes. Enjoy your floor!
lines.note: As if nothing happened.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice] To bring your car faster, we are borrowing this floor's lights. [short pause] [warmly] Back in a moment!
lines.plain: To bring your car faster, we are borrowing this floor's lights. Back in a moment!
lines.note: A favour being done for you.

lines.text: [professional] Attention, crew. Lighting on this floor will be unavailable for a short while. [short pause] [delighted] Please move about freely!
lines.plain: Attention, crew. Lighting on this floor will be unavailable for a short while. Please move about freely!
lines.note: Maintenance notice; the last line is real encouragement.

lines.text: [warmly] The lights are going out now. [short pause] It is nothing to worry about. [short pause] [Quick, light, playful pace] You may wish to run.
lines.plain: The lights are going out now. It is nothing to worry about. You may wish to run.
lines.note: The last sentence is quick and helpful, not ominous.

lines.text: [delighted] And we're back! [short pause] Your car is here. [warmly] Do hurry.
lines.plain: And we're back! Your car is here. Do hurry.
lines.note: Lights return as the car arrives.

lines.text: [Bright, cheerful voice] Lights restored! [short pause] Please make your way to the car. It is exactly where you left it.
lines.plain: Lights restored! Please make your way to the car. It is exactly where you left it.
lines.note: Cheerful about how far away that is.

lines.text: [professional] Quota met! The call button is now at your service.
lines.plain: Quota met! The call button is now at your service.
lines.note: Customer service at its most polished: the good news read like a hotel concierge.

lines.text: [delighted] Quota met! Management is SO proud of you. You may now call the car.
lines.plain: Quota met! Management is so proud of you. You may now call the car.
lines.note: Genuinely thrilled, a little too thrilled, as if the crew had won a prize.

lines.text: [warmly] That is quota, everyone! [short pause] Please call the car before anything else does.
lines.plain: That is quota, everyone! Please call the car before anything else does.
lines.note: Warm and proud; the last clause is said just as warmly, as if it were a pleasantry.

lines.text: [delighted] Your car is on its way! [short pause] One more round before we go!
lines.plain: Your car is on its way! One more round before we go!
lines.note: Chosen over: '[warmly] The car has been called! [short pause] Everybody hide, one last time.' This one confirms the call (it replaces the called line on this floor) and offers the last count as a treat; the other gives an order that 'Hide.' repeats seconds later.

lines.text: [Bright, playful, sing-song voice] Hide.
lines.plain: Hide.
lines.note: A game starting at a birthday party. One word, sung, not an order.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Coming, ready or not!
lines.plain: Coming, ready or not!
lines.note: The playground call, with real glee. It has no idea what is about to come.

lines.text: [delighted] Found you!
lines.plain: Found you!
lines.note: Pleased for them, as if they won. The caption adds the name: 'Found you, {name}!'

lines.text: [warmly] All done!
lines.plain: All done!
lines.note: End of the game, praise for everyone who played. Said the same whether anyone was found.

lines.text: [delighted] Forty.
lines.plain: Forty.
lines.note: A milestone, said as the count passes it. Counting down is fun.

lines.text: [delighted] Thirty.
lines.plain: Thirty.
lines.note: A milestone, said as the count passes it. Counting down is fun.

lines.text: [delighted] Twenty.
lines.plain: Twenty.
lines.note: A milestone, said as the count passes it. Counting down is fun.

lines.text: [delighted] Ten.
lines.plain: Ten.
lines.note: One a second with the bell. Falling, even, cheerful; the same read for every number.

lines.plain: Nine.
lines.note: One a second with the bell. Falling, even, cheerful; the same read for every number.

lines.text: [Bright, smiling announcer voice, unhurried] Hello! And welcome to Continuance. This is Lidgate, our city. Everything is measured from here. Below Lidgate, there is nothing. Almost nothing.
lines.plain: Hello! And welcome to Continuance. This is Lidgate, our city. Everything is measured from here. Below Lidgate, there is nothing. Almost nothing.
lines.note: Shots 1 to 4. The welcome; "Almost nothing." lands as a small correction, still smiling.

lines.text: [warmly] This is you. You have been sentenced. Congratulations! This is your crew. Draw your own face. We insist. Each morning, the car takes you down.
lines.plain: This is you. You have been sentenced. Congratulations! This is your crew. Draw your own face. We insist. Each morning, the car takes you down.
lines.note: Shots 5 to 7. "Congratulations!" is sincere.

lines.text: [professional] Every floor has a resident. We do not know what they are. Point your instrument at it. Record what it does. Readings become credits. Credits keep the lights on upstairs. Each resident keeps one rule. We may not tell you what it is.
lines.plain: Every floor has a resident. We do not know what they are. Point your instrument at it. Record what it does. Readings become credits. Credits keep the lights on upstairs. Each resident keeps one rule. We may not tell you what it is.
lines.note: Shots 8 to 12. A briefing: brisk, untroubled by what it is saying.

lines.text: [Quick, light, playful pace] Meet the quota. Call the car. The car is not quiet. The floor will notice. Be aboard when the doors close. Please do not stay late. Staying late is... discouraged.
lines.plain: Meet the quota. Call the car. The car is not quiet. The floor will notice. Be aboard when the doors close. Please do not stay late. Staying late is... discouraged.
lines.note: Shots 13 to 16. Quick and light; the ellipsis before "discouraged" is the only catch on the tape.

lines.text: [warmly] Then choose. Up, to bank your day. Or down, for more. Bank enough, and your sentence will end. Many crews are well on their way! [delighted] Continuance. Leave it with us.
lines.plain: Then choose. Up, to bank your day. Or down, for more. Bank enough, and your sentence will end. Many crews are well on their way! Continuance. Leave it with us.
lines.note: Shots 17 to 20. Ends on the slogan, delighted.
